food.dish: Serbian-style whole fried chicken with hot rice
food.w: The 1933 original of Barberton's Serbian-style fried chicken and a Northeast Ohio institution — whole birds fried to order in lard, served with the tangy rice-and-tomato 'hot sauce,' fresh slaw and fries. Cleveland Scene calls it a feast for the ages; ~35 min south, worth the drive.
A Barberton Serbian-fried-chicken mainstay since 1950 — crisp lard-fried quarters with the signature hot rice, slaw and fries; the childhood go-to for many locals. ~35 min south.

food.dish: Barberton fried chicken with hot rice
food.w: Norton's country roadhouse for Barberton-style chicken — juicy lard-fried birds with an especially craveable crust, the traditional hot sauce and sides, in a wood-paneled dining room that regulars swear edges out the rest. ~40 min south.
